Function Name: is_equal_to_sum_even
Description: Evaluate whether a given number n can be written as the sum of exactly 4 positive even numbers.
Parameters: 
- n: The number to be checked.
Example: is_equal_to_sum_even(16)

Reinforced Requirement: The function must determine if 'n' can be represented as the sum of exactly 4 positive even numbers. If such representation is possible, the function should return True. If not, the function should return False. Please note that all four numbers might not be unique.
